snippet.title: A Game Made In Dedication To My best Friend. Teddy's Haven - Out May 6th.
snippet.description:
🌟 Welcome to Teddy’s Haven! 🐻✨
A cozy shop simulator set in a magical high-fantasy world, Teddy’s Haven invites you to build the shop of your dreams, befriend whimsical creatures, and explore a vibrant, living world filled with wonder and charm.

In this heartwarming trailer, get a first look at:
🛒 Customizing your enchanted shop
🧪 Stocking your shelves with curious potions and enchanted materials
🌿 Harvesting rare resources in lush environments
📈 Leveling up your skills in stocking, harvesting, and more
🧚‍♀️ Hiring magical helpers and meeting quirky townsfolk
💫 And so much more!

Inspired by the boundless love of a little Pomeranian named Teddy Bear, Teddy’s Haven is more than a game—it’s a tribute to joy, friendship, and the magic of slowing down.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3615160/Teddys_Haven__A_Fantasy_Inspired_Shop_Simulator/
